target_customer: Developers and fintech platforms that want to offer invoice financing to small businesses through an API
problem: Small businesses wait weeks for invoices to be paid and platforms lack a simple way to embed invoice financing.
business_model: usage-based API with financing fees (inferred from the one-liner)

founders.name: Kingsong Chen
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; no bio shown.

founders.name: Panashe Mahachi
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; no bio shown.

competitors.name: Fundbox
competitors.what: Pays small businesses for invoices within a day via accounting software integration
competitors.traction_then: Out of stealth in April 2014; individual invoice assessment by 2016

competitors.name: Bizfi
competitors.what: Small business lending marketplace that launched an API and white label offering
competitors.traction_then: Marketplace of 35 lenders including BlueVine and Kabbage

technical_complexity.rationale: An API needs underwriting data, accounting integrations and a funding source; the credit risk and capital sourcing were harder than the software.

defensibility.rationale: A two person team without a balance sheet depended on third party capital and faced funded rivals already offering APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded fintech lenders already served the same invoices and one had an API; no evidence they acquired or copied Scanate/Fellow. BlueVine later sold its invoice factoring business to FundThrough, per a fintechfutures headline seen in search.

market_need_then: Several well funded online invoice financing firms raised money in 2014 to 2016, showing demand from small businesses for faster cash on invoices.

branding.domain_note: joinfellow.com, a prefixed domain; it returned 404 when checked in 2026-11.

rebrands.why: The YC listing joins both names; the reason and date are not sourced.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand was found; Fellow is a very common name used by many unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: Scanate/Fellow was a two person Summer 2016 team building an API for invoice financing and is listed as Inactive. No shutdown post-mortem, acquisition or funding coverage was found, so the cause of the stop is not public and failure factors stay empty. Context suggests a crowded market of funded lenders such as Fundbox and BlueVine, but that is background, not a sourced cause.
notes: Funding search and a second database search returned nothing for this company; unknown funding is not zero. The Scanate to Fellow rename is inferred from the YC listing name only. Cause of inactivity not public.
